# Lena Berding — Fashion Illustrator

> Lena Berding is a fashion illustrator and former brand manager offering
> live event illustration for fashion, beauty and lifestyle brand activations.
> Based in Berlin, Germany, available for events across Germany and Europe.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.lenaberding.com/): Overview of services.
- [Live Fashion Illustration](https://www.lenaberding.com/live-fashion-illustration.html): Live event illustration for store openings, product launches and brand activations — booking process, FAQ, pricing model.
- [About](https://www.lenaberding.com/about.html): Background as a designer, brand strategist and illustrator.
